_doc: Thermite's Exothermic Charge (research/operators/thermite.md §3; Phase 8 M5): his ability, the item in his slot 2 (Z). Placed by hand in `use.placeS` on any breakable surface, reinforced ones included (a soft or reinforced wall, a floor, a hatch, a barricade), not a hard wall; on a wall it stands on the floor below where you look (`use.toFloor`), so its hole starts at the floor; its owner's detonator sets it off (electronic: an EMP on it or on him stops the trigger, Y10S4), then it burns `burnS` with sparks on both sides before it goes off, and nothing stops it then but its destruction (any damage destroys it once placed, Fandom). Its blast cuts a large hole through every layer, steel included (data/destruction.json `explosives.exothermic_charge`: a reinforced hatch whole), and the panels within `blast.cutM` of it too (Fandom: adjacent walls, hatches and floors); 220 hp on the far side (Y11S3.1), lethal close and none past `blast.damage.zeroM`; on his own side only at point blank. Three a round (Y10S4). Its placing time, size, reach, the damage curves, destruction range and the adjacent reach are placeholders.
name: Exothermic Charge
